summary.text: Steven Jackson is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 2 (Bossier and Caddo parishes), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Steven Jackson's occupation as Healthcare Technology and Used Car Dealer.
It lists education as Woodlawn High School; Grambling State University; Louisiana State University of Shreveport.

The page lists committee assignments including Health and Welfare, Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs, Ways and Means, and the Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus affiliations including the Democratic Caucus and the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus.
